Name: Clean And Visible Standard Farm
Author: TheDark163
Description:
[size=4][b]What does this map do?[/b][/size]
It is a clean version of the Standard map where absolutely all tiles are 100% visible.

* [b]No more annoying ponds:[/b] I removed the ponds from the middle to clear up space, but you can still refill your watering can from the right edge of the map, where there is a pond that stays out of the way.
* [b]Bottom grass line:[/b] To make everything perfectly visible, the very bottom row is grass, not tillable dirt. You cannot plant crops or place Robin's buildings there, but you CAN place chests, furnaces, scarecrows, and furniture.
[size=1][b]Why did I do this?:[/b] If that line were dirt, the fences on the border would block the view of the crops behind them, and it wouldn't be 100% visible anymore. [/size]

[size=4][b]A personal note[/b][/size]
This is the first thing I've ever uploaded. I made it for myself because I couldn't find any map on Nexus that I actually liked; they all had the bottom edge cut off by a cliff, which only lets you see half of your crop.

Is leaving a non-tillable grass line technically the same as having the cliff? Yes, maybe. But visually it looks way better and I prefer it this way.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Extract the ZIP file into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.

[size=4][b]Feedback[/b][/size]
If you find any bugs, errors, or have any feedback, please let me know in the "Posts" tab.
